fileName: Firbolg Master of the Wild Hunt.monster
name: Firbolg Master of the Wild Hunt

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

weaknesses.name: Necrotic
weaknesses.details: (if the firbolg master of the Wild Hunt takes necrotic damage, its regeneration does not function on its next turn)

items.name: Light Shield
items.description: While you’re using a light shield, you can use your shield hand to hold another item, to climb, and the like, but you can’t make attacks with that hand or with anything in it.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Moonhunter
traits.details: A firbolg master of the Wild Hunt’s attacks deal 2d6 extra damage to a creature affected by moonfire.

effect.description: The firbolg master of the Wild Hunt’s spear returns after the master makes the attack
The firbolg master of the Wild Hunt makes two spear of the hunt attacks

The firbolg master of the Wild Hunt makes a spear of the hunt attack or a spear the prey attack against a bloodied enemy. On a hit, the attack becomes a critical hit and deals 6d6 extra damage. If the attack reduces the target to 0 hit points or fewer, the master gains 1 action point

hit.description: until the end of the firbolg master of the Wild Hunt’s next turn, the target is marked, grants combat advantage to the master, and cannot benefit from invisibility or concealment
